slides.headline: 1) AI THAT GAINS SKILLS WITHOUT LOSING OLD ONES
slides.body:
THE AI TOOLS YOU PAY FOR TODAY FORGET EVERYTHING THEY LEARN.

Google's gaming AI doesn't. It layers new abilities on top of old ones, the way people do

YOUR AI ASSISTANT STARTS FROM ZERO EVERY TIME YOU OPEN IT.

ONE AI CAN DO A LOT. A GROUP THAT COOPERATES CAN DO ANYTHING.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 4 GOOGLE AI BREAKTHROUGHS
slides.body:
✓ Learns without forgetting old skills
✓ Memory beyond any chat window
✓ Plans across months and years
✓ Agents that cooperate and negotiate

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 4 👇 Google has used video games as its AI lab for 15 years. Here's what those games actually built.

Continual learning: gains new skills without ever losing old ones, deep memory that stores months of context far beyond any chat window, long-horizon planning where agents hold goals across weeks and months, and multi-agent dynamics where AI agents cooperate, negotiate, and manage economics, all tested inside the FenrisCreations game world.

Google has been cracking the hardest AI problems inside video games since 2009. Memory that never fades, planning that spans years, agents that negotiate: these stop being game problems the moment they ship.
